meta.title: Ondra Speech Gate
meta.description: Decides whether a given line should be spoken out loud: the master switch, six to thirty characters, enough emotional intensity (or an emotion word in the line), three seconds since the last utterance, and a rule that after two spoken lines in a row the next one stays text only. It decides but never speaks — each decision carries the real character count, the intensity, the rate to use, and a reason code when blocked. Missing emotion data means a degraded pass, and a missing synthesis channel is reported as no channel at all.
